orderingPolicy: Order the 19 alumni by earliest documented year of joining Sepulchre as PhD student or postdoc. More explicit personal career records are used for Franci and Miranda-Villatoro where they conflict with the roster. Rodolphe Sepulchre is placed last for his response and close.
publicOrderingCaption: The proposed talks follow the year each alumnus joined Rodolphe as a PhD student or postdoc. Speakers from the same year are listed alphabetically by surname. Rodolphe closes the day.
publicDateCaveat: Public sources differ on the start year for Alessio Franci (roster: 2011; personal biography: 2012) and Felix A. Miranda-Villatoro (roster: 2017; personal biography: March 2018). The programme uses their personal biographies.
